    "7c4911b2: ;\n .;This routine is used to edit the ^VAS(393 file.\n .;It contains EDIT, INPUT, and OUTPUT templates.\n .;",
    "ae926220: ;Call the data dictionary utilities to initialize variables.",
    "ca300662: ;Set up the file entry variables for editing.",
    "51ae1f37: ;If the field .01 has data, save it in DE(1).",
    "63d21729: ;Clean up %Z and quit.",
    "948ba17d: ;Write the field label and colon.",
    "5dc191cd: ;Quit.",
    "d6e41ec9: ;Call the word wrap output routine if the response is too long.",
    "a08e7e02: ;If the field is free text or key type, branch to the freetext word wrap routine.",
    "9c18bfe4: ;If the field is read-only, display 'No Editing' and quit.",
    "0d5e749c: ;Read user's response, set timeout, write * if timed out.",
    "defaa5e8: ;Quit",
    "0167ec2e: ;Increment the DO level",
    "a949f472: ;Transfer control using the DO level",
    "9c05bb82: ;If there is a data element, go to the PR label, otherwise write and transfer control",
    "a70ca90d: ;If X is null, go to different labels based on conditions involving DV, D, and DQ",
    "5d42bd8d: ;If X is a question mark, go to QS label, else if X is a caret, do the D subroutine and go to ^DIE17",
    "7647c2d0: ;If X is an @ symbol, do the D subroutine and go to Z^DIE2",
    "e117857d: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and there is a DIE value for the user, set X to that value and write it if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S'",
    "b858eae0: ;Go to different labels based on conditions involving DV, DP, DIFLD, and DIC(\"S\"), or execute code related to Y, DU, and DB(DQ)",
    "694ca422: Quit if the data element is undefined or the input variable X is not found in the data element.",
    "f2d7adb1: Write the data element portion after the colon if it is defined, and set X to the portion before the colon.",
    "8261521a: If the .01 field specifies a pointer to a file, look up the entry and set X to the .01 value of the entry found. If no entry is found, set X to a negative value and go to the exit point.",
    "c7f5c2ff: If the .01 field is not numeric, go to the exit point. If the value in X is longer than 24 characters and contains a decimal point, discard X and go to the exit point.",
    "fdf63cb4: If the data type specifies a numeric decimal, clean up the numeric value by removing leading/trailing zeros and decimal points as needed.",
    "68f07a4e: ;Kill and quit if the input variable is null.",
    "8f137488: ;Save input X and set default global node values for DIE.",
    "34f5f27b: ;If a data dictionary definition exists for this field, branch.",
    "04a20a66: ;Set X to a bad value code.",
    "0e30a716: ;Execute validation code and quit if valid input.",
    "a9791331: ;Set up data for DIFLD array.",
    "7e9504f4: ;If data is not edited, save X as Y and branch based on conditions.",
    "17fd338b: ;Get data from ^DD global and execute any specified code.",
    "5a6729db: ;If pointer type, get data from pointed-to file.",
    "9d27fd38: ;If variable pointer, get data from pointed-to global.",
    "24de0d12: ;If set of codes, get external value from set.",
    "df6c9c94: ;Set X to null external form of the old data. Quit or branch as appropriate.",
    "275c54e4: ;If this is an identifier field, quit.",
    "6f35d508: ;Re-transform, kill data left over from XECUTE\"RD\", quit if RD succeeds.",
    "561be12b: ;Quit.",
    "de9f0f80: ;Set names and default values.",
    "c36262c4: ;Variable initialization for XECUTE\"RE\".",
    "df4fa1b8: ;Branch to execute the reader.",
    "6241f8e6: ;Prompt for date transcribed.",
    "370a1549: ;Quit.",
    "9529d5df: ;Perform operations required by VA FileMan.",
    "2eeb3edb: ;If date is before DATE DICTATED, display error message and quit.",
    "02b29b5b: ;Check if the value of the DG variable is greater than 9 before proceeding.",
    "b64a1f4d: ;If the user's input value (X) is empty, then set DGJTST to 'DICTATED' and Y to '@2'. Otherwise, set DIC(0) to 'F' (which stands for 'FileMan'), DW to the value of DQ, and call the OUT^DIE17 routine.",
    "96610cc7: ;If the user's input value (X) is empty, set DGJTST to 'DICTATED' and Y to '@2'.",
    "def4563c: ;Exit the current execution.",
    "8f6bf155: ;If the value of the DG variable is greater than 9, call the F^DIE17 routine and then branch to the ^DGJXA12 routine."
  ]
}
